fusions.name: Drawn Dose
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target: fires a round at an enemy up to 9 tiles away that draws the affliction out, using it up, and deals 8 poison damage.

fusions.name: Lancet
fusions.desc: Fires a round that lances an enemy up to 7 tiles away for 12 poison damage, leaves it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on it then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Return to Sender
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Bitter Chamber
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions on an enemy wears off, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
